newsitem.title: USA: Tyco International buys Zettler GmbH.
newsitem.headline: Tyco International buys Zettler GmbH.

text.p: Tyco International Ltd said on Thursday it acquired Germany's Zettler GmbH, which makes, installs and services fire detection and security systems, for undisclosed terms.
The acquisition was expected to be immediately accretive to earnings, the company said.
Zettler had revenues of $160 million over the past 12 months, Tyco said. The company has sales and service offices in Germany, Switzerland and France, with other offices in Europe, it said.
Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Dennis Kozlowski said Zettler was a good fit with Tyco's worldwide fire protection group and its recently acquired Thorn Security group.
